notes: The supplied *which* before *said* is correctly `added`: the antecedent `הַלַּיְלָה` is written and no relative morpheme stands, so rule 46's closing sentence hands it to rule 55.
`בּוֹ` → *wherein* is one two-morpheme fusion headed on the preposition, since no relative morpheme stands here (rules 22, 30).
*There is ... conceived* keeps the presentative dummy with the verb under rule 17; *a man child* heads on *man* by rule 31's subtraction.
